paragraphs.text:
If anyone is with you, they lose their nerve and refuse to go 
further. If you can succeed in a combined Climb and Jump roll, 
you get down quietly (see following). Fail the roll and you tumble 
down uncontrollably, go to 573. 
If you succeeded, now attempt a Luck and a Know (EDU) roll: 
• If you succeed with both the combined Climb and Jump, and 
the Luck and Know (EDU) rolls, go to 565.
• If you failed any of these rolls, go to 566. 
• If you failed two or more, go to 567.
(570)
